meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 当你要求操作Git提交记录或查询历史时，Claude会使用专业的Git命令来处理，包括分段提交、改写分支历史、查找代码变更等，同时确保操作安全并保留未更改的工作。
howto.when: 当你需要提交代码、查看Git历史、或者问“谁写了这行代码”时触发。技能不用于普通代码编辑。

say.text: 帮我提交当前所有修改。
say.note: Claude会检查改动，按原子性拆分多个提交。

say.text: 查看这个文件是谁最后修改的。
say.note: Claude会使用git blame定位具体行。

say.text: 把最近三个提交合并成一个。

howto.what_en: When you ask Claude to operate on Git history or answer Git-history questions, it uses precise Git commands for atomic commits, rebasing, squashing, fixing, blaming, bisecting, and more. It ensures safety by checking branch status and recovery paths.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever you need to commit, investigate Git history, or ask who modified a piece of code. It is not used for ordinary code edits unless you explicitly request Git work.

say_en.note: Claude will inspect diffs and split into atomic commits.
Claude uses git blame to find the author and commit.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Claude will rebase interactively with autosquash.
